MatrixState.title: MatrixState
MatrixState.description: Stores the current state of the 33-dimension BIM Maturity Matrix for Mesh Estudio.

selections.description: Map of the 33 BIM maturity dimension IDs to their selected level index (0 to 4).

scorePercentage.description: Computed overall BIM maturity percentage from 0 to 100.

maturityCategory.description: Classification label of the achieved BIM maturity level.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last save operation.

ImplementationGoals.title: ImplementationGoals
ImplementationGoals.description: Stores executive BIM implementation targets per category, item and timeline for Mesh Estudio.

targetSelections.description: Target level (0 to 4) for each of the 33 BIM maturity dimensions.

categoryTargets.description: Target percentage (0 to 100) for each of the 5 categories.

targetScorePercentage.description: Overall target maturity score from 0 to 100.

targetPeriod.description: Target timeline label or quarter (e.g. Q4 2026).

responsibleRole.description: Lead role or department responsible for reaching the targets.

notes.description: Executive notes and strategic justification for the implementation goals.

Iso9001MatrixState.title: Iso9001MatrixState
Iso9001MatrixState.description: Stores the current state of the 21-requirement ISO 9001 Quality Management System Matrix for Mesh Estudio.

selections.description: Map of the 21 ISO 9001 requirement IDs to their selected level index (0 to 4).

scorePercentage.description: Computed overall ISO 9001 quality score from 0 to 100.

maturityCategory.description: Classification label of the achieved quality maturity level.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last save operation.

Iso9001ImplementationGoals.title: Iso9001ImplementationGoals
Iso9001ImplementationGoals.description: Stores executive ISO 9001 Quality System targets per clause, item and timeline for Mesh Estudio.

targetSelections.description: Target level (0 to 4) for each of the 21 ISO 9001 requirements.

categoryTargets.description: Target percentage (0 to 100) for each of the 7 clauses.

targetScorePercentage.description: Overall target quality score from 0 to 100.

targetPeriod.description: Target timeline label or quarter (e.g. Q4 2026).

responsibleRole.description: Lead role or department responsible for reaching the targets.

notes.description: Executive notes and strategic justification for the quality targets.

/matrices/{matrixId}.description: Singleton document (mesh_estudio) storing the BIM Maturity Matrix progress.

/goals/{goalId}.description: Singleton document (mesh_estudio) storing the BIM Implementation Goals and targets.

/matrices_iso9001/{matrixId}.description: Singleton document (mesh_estudio) storing the ISO 9001 Quality Matrix progress.

/goals_iso9001/{goalId}.description: Singleton document (mesh_estudio) storing the ISO 9001 Quality Goals and targets.
